next_step: Run 2-week POC: ingest 10M SKUs, benchmark embeddings + rerank pipeline w/ holiday traffic profile
notes:
Top-line: Shelfwise is a mid-market DTC + marketplace operator with ~9M active SKUs and heavy seasonality (Black Friday/Cyber week = ~5-6x baseline qps). Current stack: Elastic for text search + a cross-encoder reranker in-house (GPU-hosted, very expensive), Pinecone used for a small personalization index. Primary objectives: improve relevance on short queries, cut cost-per-query for embeddings+rerank, and guarantee tail latency during promotional spikes.

Key technical targets / asks (from Head of Search & CTO):
- Indexing scale: ingest 8-12M SKUs, daily partial re-index for price/availability deltas. Need write throughput for nightly windows (delta ingestion target: <6 hours).
- Latency SLOs: target p50 < 80ms for search+rerank, p95 < 300ms under 1x baseline; must remain < 500ms p95 at 5x traffic.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (embedding + retrieval + rerank) < $0.002 on average; willing to trade some latency for cost but not at top-funnel relevance loss.
- Rerank model: prefer a distilled cross-encoder or 2-stage bi-encoder + lightweight cross-encoder for top-50; evaluating Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantized reranker.
- Embedding policy: 1536 dims considered, but open to 1024 quantized if storage/cost wins; need recommendations.
- Caching and batching: want automatic prefix/KV caching and short-term hot-item caching for sale items (expected TTLs: 2-6 hours).
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to smaller model variants when dedicated capacity is saturated in holiday peaks.

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required, audit logging and KMS key integration for index encryption, data residency preference: US + EU. Legal team flagged standard data residency CLA (blocker until redlined).

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If we can't hold p50 < 120ms at 6x traffic, we won't move production. Holiday traffic is make-or-break." — Head of Search (Ana Gomez).
- "Cost per query is what keeps the execs up at night. We need clear unit economics for worst-case peak." — CTO (Mark Li).

POC scope proposed:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): ingest 10M SKUs, build ANN index + embedding store, run query replay (week-long traffic trace scaled to 1x and 5x), measure p50/p95 and cost-per-1M-queries.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): enable reranking pipeline for top-100 -> top-10, evaluate relevance uplift vs current baseline (CTR / add-to-cart delta), test fallback routing and dedicated pool configs.

Current constraints / internal notes:
- Data team will only allow a VPC endpoint; no public endpoints for raw PII (although SKU metadata is non-PII).
- Legal needs a short addendum for EU residency; slows procurement.
- SE asks: want a baked example of quantized reranker performance and a cost projection for holiday 6x traffic.

CRM shorthand next steps:

- Schedule infra walkthrough w/ infra ops (VPC + KMS) next week.
- Get redline from legal on data residency language (drive link in doc list).
